versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

- Initial release of the dataify-google-patents skill.
- Converts Google Patents requests into Dataify Scraper API calls.
- Enforces a strict parameter confirmation flow with a required Markdown parameter table before each call.
- Uses only documented default values for parameters; does not invent or assume defaults from examples.
- Handles all user parameter modifications with iterative table previews and explicit user confirmation.
- Requires users to provide a Dataify API token and instructs sign-in if missing.
